headline: Iran launches drone attacks on US military bases in Kuwait and Jordan
summary: Iran's military has reportedly targeted several US military infrastructures, including an ammunition depot in Kuwait and a military fuel tank at an airbase in Jordan, according to Tasnim News.
details: Iran launched drone attacks on US military bases in Kuwait and Jordan, as reported by Al-Jazeera on Saturday, July 18, citing Tasnim News.

According to Tasnim News, the Iranian military targeted several US military infrastructures. These included an ammunition depot at Camp Udairi in Kuwait, Al Salem Air Base, its headquarters building, and nearby connecting bridges.
In Jordan, targets included military fuel tanks at Al-Azraq Air Base.
The Iranian military has issued a warning, stating that any power attempting to test the morale of the Iranian nation will face the "steel-hard resolve and response" of its armed forces.
caption:
Iran has reportedly launched drone attacks on US military bases in Kuwait and Jordan.

Iran launched drone attacks on US military bases in Kuwait and Jordan, as reported by Al-Jazeera on Saturday, July 18, citing Tasnim News.

According to Tasnim News, the Iranian military targeted several US military infrastructures. These included an ammunition depot at Camp Udairi in Kuwait, Al Salem Air Base, its headquarters building, and nearby connecting bridges.

In Jordan, targets included military fuel tanks at Al-Azraq Air Base.

The Iranian military has issued a warning, stating that any power attempting to test the morale of the Iranian nation will face the "steel-hard resolve and response" of its armed forces.

headline_marked: [[US launches airstrikes in Southern Iran]] for seventh consecutive night
headline: US launches airstrikes in Southern Iran for seventh consecutive night
summary: US airstrikes have continued in Southern Iran for the seventh night, with explosions reported in Bandar Abbas and Sirik. This comes amidst escalating tensions, including Iran's targeting of a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
details: The United States has launched airstrikes in Southern Iran for the seventh consecutive night. Explosions were heard in the southern Iranian port cities of Bandar Abbas and Sirik shortly after the US military began its seventh night of air operations on Friday.
Iran International reported this information on Saturday, July 18. This escalation follows reports from Iranian media detailing multiple explosions in the region.

Meanwhile, Tehran stated that its Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targeted a Thai-flagged vessel in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday. The IRGC claimed the ship attempted to cross without permission and ignored warnings.

According to an Axios report, the Trump administration is considering a significant expansion of US military operations against Iran. This includes plans to send dozens more aerial refueling planes to Israel.

Iran also announced on Friday that it had attacked a US special operations command center in Syria's Al-Tanf region. The US Central Command later confirmed the attack, stating that no US personnel were killed or injured.

US President Donald Trump commented on the situation, asserting that the United States is achieving a major victory regarding Iran. He added that the results of this victory would become clear very soon.
